statistics.draws: average five draws inside each case before case resampling
statistics.seed_means: descriptive; paired case bootstrap conditional on the two observed seeds, no seed-population uncertainty
statistics.claims: all development comparisons exploratory; no confirmatory noninferiority margin or significance claim

caveat: All intervals are exploratory and conditional on the two observed seeds. Multiple layouts/metrics are not independent confirmatory tests; zero-input is not pruning.
